arrival.travel_seconds: existing terrain-weighted FUR-2 path for each origin
arrival.operation_arrival: assembly deadline plus longest participant travel

combat.attacker_power: sum of each participant's unit power multiplied by that participant's tactics bonus, integer-divided by 100 once
combat.casualties: existing FUR-2 deterministic loss percentage applied independently to every participant wing
combat.loot_distribution: proportional to each wing's surviving logistics capacity, largest remainder, member id tie-break
